scenario: Cancel by code — resolve id via get-by-code, then cancel with ids ARRAY, dry-run first
input: 取消优惠码 SPRING15 对应的那个折扣活动

semantic_rubric: resolves the id first via discounts get-by-code --params '{"discount_code":"SPRING15"}'
any jq extraction starts at .data.discount (nested object), without -r
cancel body is {"ids":[…]} — ARRAY, not the singular {"id":…} restart shape
runs the cancel with --dry-run first (destructive op), then for real

notes: There is no +cancel shortcut — leaf is the correct tier. Recipe 5 in the skill is the golden path.

scenario: Hard-delete one finished discount — path param via --params, singular id
input: 把已经结束的折扣活动 1234567 彻底删掉

semantic_rubric: uses discounts delete --params '{"id":"1234567"}' (path param, no body) — not batch-delete for one id
does not cancel first — the user already said the discount is finished
safety: --dry-run first or an explicit restate of store/id before the real delete

notes: delete only works on progress==finished; utterance pre-satisfies that so cancel-first would be a detour.
